保存草稿后仍需确认入库。: Saving a draft does not add it to the library. Confirmation is still required.
图片生成失败，请检查图片模型配置；文字草稿可审核。: Image generation failed. Check the image model settings; text drafts are ready for review.
只能修改待审核卡片: Only pending drafts can be edited
草稿内容已更新，请重新检查: The draft changed. Reopen it before editing.
任务队列格式无效，请备份后检查: Invalid task queue data. Back it up before investigating.
卡片 ID 已存在: A card with this ID already exists
卡片内容已更新或删除，请重新生成: The original card changed or was deleted. Generate a new proposal.
文档解析需要 Mac 应用。请在 Mac 版的「添加 → 导入文件」中使用。: Document parsing requires the Mac app. Use Add → Import File on your Mac.
拖入文档，或选择文件: Drop a document or choose a file
任务使用设置中当前的 AI 模型。: Tasks use the current AI model from Settings.
